# eDrumSynth: MicroDexed-touch's drum engine as an LV2 instrument
#
#   cmake -B build -G Ninja && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
#   cmake --install build --prefix /usr     # -> /usr/lib/lv2/edrumsynth.lv2
#
# The TTL (edrumsynth.lv2/*.ttl) and src/ports.h are generated by
# tools/gen_ttl.c and committed: cross builds don't run the generator.
# After changing the generator or the engine's tables:
#   cmake --build build --target regenerate
# No architecture specific flags here: they come from the build (CFLAGS).

cmake_minimum_required (VERSION 3.16)
project (edrumsynth VERSION 0.0.1 LANGUAGES C)

option (EDS_TESTS "build the tests (ctest)" ON)

set (CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set (CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)		# gnu17: the engine needs C17 or older
set (CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if (NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
	set (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif ()

find_path (LV2_INCLUDE_DIR lv2/core/lv2.h)
if (NOT LV2_INCLUDE_DIR)
	message (FATAL_ERROR "LV2 headers (lv2/core/lv2.h) not found: install the LV2 development package")
endif ()
find_library (MATH_LIBRARY m)

set (ENGINE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/engine/Synth_LXR)
set (ENGINE_SRC ${ENGINE}/src/lxr_engine.c)
set (BUNDLE edrumsynth.lv2)
set (BUNDLE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${BUNDLE})

# the engine: one translation unit with the firmware sources; their own
# include paths (they have a config.h) and no warnings (firmware code)
set_source_files_properties (${ENGINE_SRC} PROPERTIES
	INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${ENGINE}/lxr;${ENGINE}/lxr/shim"
	COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")

# ---- the TTL generator (desktop only) ----

if (NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
	add_executable (gen_ttl tools/gen_ttl.c ${ENGINE_SRC})
	target_include_directories (gen_ttl PRIVATE ${ENGINE}/src ${ENGINE}/lxr ${ENGINE}/lxr/shim)
	if (MATH_LIBRARY)
		target_link_libraries (gen_ttl PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
	endif ()
	add_custom_target (regenerate
		COMMAND gen_ttl ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${BUNDLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ports.h
		COMMAND gen_ttl --symbols > ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/symbols.txt
		DEPENDS gen_ttl
		COMMENT "regenerating ${BUNDLE}/*.ttl and src/ports.h in the source tree"
		VERBATIM)
endif ()
